result:
Survey written to `operations/engineering/records/sessions/research/relationality-triage-survey.md`.

**Key findings across ~107 files:**

- **14 READY** (13%): The 10 cellular computation specs are a complete, polished specification stack (Layers 2-6) ready to move as a unit. The climate essay and ActivityPub dead-zone paper are publication-quality.

- **26 NEEDS EDITING** (24%): The three core mathematical texts (`relationality.md`, `on-relationality.md`, `acts-derivation-trace.md`) are the intellectual heart — a generative calculus of relations from a single primitive (reflexive witnessing) through acts, traces, closure-flow-shuffle operators, type theory, and spectral geometry. They need frontmatter and possibly splitting. The universe papers (`semiotic-universe.md` at 70%, `hypertensor-topos-math-paper.md` at 80-90%) are close to complete. Five theoretical babbles contain genuinely novel philosophical claims (stationarity/ergodicity applied to climate, measuring ideologies by homogeneity requirements, paracosm/secondary-world distinction, counter-emergence thesis, californication critique).

- **67 NEEDS RESEARCH** (63%): Mostly babbles and fediverse posts serving as primary source material, plus incomplete math stubs and unrun experiments.

The survey recommends a 5-phase integration order starting with the cellular computation stack, then the two polished research papers, then the core mathematics (which likely needs a new `science/math/domains/relationality/` domain), then the theoretical babbles restructured as proper texts, then the semiotics introduction suite.
